combat_design.request: Make Black play and fight as close as possible to Miguel O'Hara in Across the Spider-Verse; make it fun. Revision 1 review: avoid one-trick pinning, answer bosses, add webbing and air combos, add rows as needed within the 2D mob/boss brawler.
